<!--
This file carries the shape and nothing else. The shape comes from the method's handbook —
`agent-manual/pull-request.md` in nanatsusaya/agent-project-rules — and is the same in every project
that takes it; if it is wrong it is wrong everywhere, so it is fixed there, not here.

How to fill it — which sections are always answered, where the answer to an open question goes, how
to write a closing keyword — is in CLAUDE.md → "Delivery workflow & PRs". An agent that writes a
description from a file never opens this one, so an instruction kept here would reach only somebody
typing in a browser.

**Content sources is this project's one declared addition**, and the handbook allows exactly one. It
earns the slot because here a fact with no source does not ship: a change touching a price, an opening
time or an address cannot be judged at all until a reviewer knows where each value came from. Declared
here so a later reader can tell a section somebody chose from one that drifted in.
-->

## What

<!-- What this change does, concretely. -->

## Why

<!-- The problem it solves. If it follows from a decision or a ticket, say which, and link it. -->

## Content sources

<!-- Where each business fact this change touches comes from — docs/content/, an ADR, or the owner.
     "none" if it touches no business content. -->

## Verified

<!-- How you know it works. Name the commands you ran and what they returned — not what they would
     have returned. Anything with observable behaviour was exercised, not merely built. State what you
     did NOT verify. -->

## Open questions

     CLAUDE.md. -->
